scope: All 19 hand-drawn raster illustrations displayed by the English and Russian nigiri recipes, including hero, ingredient cards, preparation, shaping panels/insets and serving.
method: Direct manual reinspection of all 19 full-size shipped assets and replacement originals, followed by an independent critic of hand anatomy, finger length, food contacts and instruction alignment. Check one thumb plus four fingers, relative lengths, joint/palm connections, foreshortening and crop/occlusion in every panel/inset. Occluded digits cannot be individually verified. Hash tests verify freshness only, not anatomy.
style: Warm hand-drawn Japanese animation, thin brown outlines, matte cel shading; no photorealistic skin or geometric blueprints.
